t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two different groups of gnomes - the pink, red, purple and brown go to the red basket and the blue, yellow, orange and green go to the yellow basket. The choice of basket is alternate to if you choose the red basket, keep doing so until it starts to decrease the amount of mushrooms. Only then decide to swap to the yellow basket but you'll know if you've done it too soon as you'll only see 0 or 1 mushroom

vb_textbox.text: There are two groups of gnomes, each with 4 colours of gnomes. The pink, red, purple and brown gnomes lead to the red basket and the blue, yellow, orange and green gnomes lead to the yellow basket. Choose which group you want to start with, memorise the colours and if you are seeing more than 4 mushrooms being produced out of that colour basket, stick with it as long as it's producing more than 3 mushrooms. If it's producing 3 or less mushrooms, swap to the other group and start collecting until it too produces 3 or less mushrooms and so on. It helps to have your fingers over the keys and you'll soon get use to remembering which gnome is in which group.
